meaning.en: the sacred syllable
the brahmin named Trishikhi
went to the world of the Sun
Lord, what is the body?
what is the life-breath?
what is the cause?
what is the self?
all this is Shiva alone
eternal, pure, stainless
all-pervading, without a second
like a heated lump of iron
meaning.hi: तपे हुए लोहे के गोले की तरह

meaning.en: appears as if divided
what is it that illumines this?
meaning.hi: इसे प्रकाशित करने वाला क्या है?

meaning.en: that which the word 'existence' names
Brahman mixed with ignorance
from Brahman, the unmanifest
from the unmanifest, the great principle
from the great principle, the sense of 'I'
the five subtle elements
the five gross elements
the entire world
what is this 'entire' world?
the transformations and divisions of the elements, and so on
meaning.hi: तत्त्वों के परिवर्तन और विभाजन आदि

meaning.en: in a single body
the difference between effect and cause
portion, principle, name and named, place
meaning.hi: अंश, तत्त्व, नाम और नामवाला, स्थान

meaning.en: object, presiding deity, sheath
space is the inner instrument
mind, intellect, thought, sense of 'I'
air is the five breaths
fire is hearing, touch, sight, taste and smell
meaning.hi: अग्नि कान, त्वचा, आँख, जीभ और नाक है

meaning.en: water is sound, touch, form, taste and smell
meaning.hi: जल शब्द, स्पर्श, रूप, रस और गन्ध है

meaning.en: earth is speech, hands, feet, excretion and generation
meaning.hi: पृथ्वी वाणी, हाथ, पैर, गुदा और जननेन्द्रिय है

meaning.en: knowing, intending, deciding, reflecting, claiming as one's own
the functions of the space-born inner instrument
meaning.hi: आकाश से बने अन्तःकरण के काम

meaning.en: balancing, lifting, grasping, hearing, breathing out
meaning.hi: सन्तुलन, उठाना, पकड़ना, सुनना, साँस छोड़ना

meaning.en: the functions of the air-born breaths
meaning.hi: वायु से बने प्राणों के काम

meaning.en: sound, touch, form, taste, smell
the objects of the fire-born knowing-senses
meaning.hi: अग्नि से बनी ज्ञानेन्द्रियों के विषय

meaning.en: resting on water
speaking, taking, walking, releasing, enjoying
meaning.hi: बोलना, लेना, चलना, त्यागना, आनन्द लेना

meaning.en: the functions of the earth-born doing-organs
meaning.hi: पृथ्वी से बनी कर्मेन्द्रियों के काम

meaning.en: the objects of the breath-essences are included within
meaning.hi: प्राण के सूक्ष्म विषय भीतर समाए हैं

meaning.en: thought and 'I'-sense are included within
meaning.hi: चित्त और अहंकार भीतर समाए हैं

meaning.en: making room, shaking off, seeing, gathering into a mass, holding steady
meaning.hi: जगह बनाना, झाड़ना, देखना, पिण्ड बनाना, धारण करना

meaning.en: the subtlest of all
objects of the living essence
meaning.hi: जीव के सूक्ष्म तत्त्व के विषय

meaning.en: twelve limbs
belonging to self, to elements, to gods
meaning.hi: आत्मा, तत्त्वों और देवताओं से सम्बन्धित

words.sanskrit: nishakara chaturmukha dik vata arka varuna ashvi agni indra upendra prajapati yamah

meaning.en: Moon, Brahma, Directions, Wind, Sun, Varuna, Ashvins, Fire, Indra, Vishnu, Prajapati, Yama
meaning.hi: चन्द्र, ब्रह्मा, दिशाएँ, वायु, सूर्य, वरुण, अश्विनी, अग्नि, इन्द्र, विष्णु, प्रजापति, यम

meaning.en: in the form of the presiding gods of the senses
meaning.hi: इन्द्रियों के अधिष्ठाता देवताओं के रूप में

meaning.en: the breaths moving within the twelve channels
meaning.hi: बारह नाड़ियों में चलने वाले प्राण

meaning.en: the knowledge of the limbs is itself the knower
meaning.hi: अंगों का ज्ञान ही ज्ञाता है

meaning.en: of space, air, fire, water and food
meaning.hi: आकाश, वायु, अग्नि, जल और अन्न का

meaning.en: fivefold blending
the knower, joined with the balancing breath
through the ear, as the quality of sound
seated in speech
rests in space
the mind, joined with the pervading breath, through the skin as touch
meaning.hi: मन, व्यान के साथ, त्वचा द्वारा स्पर्श-गुण

meaning.en: the intellect, joined with the rising breath, through the eye as form
meaning.hi: बुद्धि, उदान के साथ, आँख द्वारा रूप-गुण

meaning.en: seated in the feet, resting in fire
meaning.hi: पैरों में स्थित, अग्नि में टिकी

meaning.en: thought, joined with the downward breath, through the tongue as taste
meaning.hi: चित्त, अपान के साथ, जीभ द्वारा रस-गुण

meaning.en: seated in the organ of generation, resting in water
meaning.hi: जननेन्द्रिय में स्थित, जल में टिका

meaning.en: the 'I'-sense, joined with the forward breath, through the nose as smell
meaning.hi: अहंकार, प्राण के साथ, नाक द्वारा गन्ध-गुण

meaning.en: seated in the organ of excretion, resting in earth
meaning.hi: गुदा में स्थित, पृथ्वी में टिका

meaning.en: one who knows this
on this there are these verses
meaning.hi: इस विषय में ये श्लोक हैं

meaning.en: in each separated element, sixteen parts
meaning.hi: अलग हुए हर तत्त्व में सोलह कलाएँ

meaning.en: their own shares and the higher shares, in order
meaning.hi: अपने और ऊपर के हिस्से, क्रम से

meaning.en: inner instrument, pervading breath, eye, taste, excretion, space, in sequence
meaning.hi: अन्तःकरण, व्यान, आँख, रस, गुदा, आकाश के क्रम से

meaning.en: from the chief element
through the earlier and later shares
meaning.hi: पहले और बाद के हिस्सों से

meaning.en: four by four in each element
first leaning on space
standing in earth and the rest
above the chief element
the higher ones are to be known
the lower do not know those above
meaning.hi: नीचे वाले ऊपर वालों को नहीं जानते

meaning.en: thus a portion came to be
from that, and from those, a portion
therefore
depending on one another
woven warp and weft in order
meaning.hi: क्रम से ताने-बाने की तरह गुँथे

meaning.en: the earth made of the five elements
it is joined with consciousness
from that, plants and food
from that, bodies of four kinds
nourishing fluid, blood, flesh, fat
bone, marrow, seed
the tissues, the building materials
some bodies from the joining of those
in some cases arising from the elements
within it
the sheath made of food
centred on the region of the navel
in the middle of this is the heart
with its stalk
like a lotus bud
the powers dwelling in its clear core
meaning.hi: इसके निर्मल भीतरी भाग में रहने वाली शक्तियाँ

meaning.en: the doer, the 'I'-sense and consciousness
its seed
a lump of darkness
delusion in form, dull, dense
it sits leaning on the throat
this world is a mixture
the inmost self whose nature is joy
in the crown of the head
in the supreme seat
joined with limitless power
shines forth as the world
meaning.hi: संसार के रूप में प्रकाशित होता है

meaning.en: waking is present everywhere
dreaming is present within waking
deep sleep and the fourth state too
meaning.hi: गहरी नींद और चौथी अवस्था भी

meaning.en: not in the other states anywhere
threaded through every place
taking four forms
Shiva by nature
just as in a large fruit
all the juices set everything in motion
meaning.hi: सारे रस सब कुछ चलाते हैं

meaning.en: so too
within the sheath made of food
the sheaths stand inside
as the sheath, so the living soul
as the living soul, so Shiva
the living soul is subject to change
Shiva is beyond change
the sheaths are its changing forms
they drive the states
meaning.hi: वे ही अवस्थाओं को चलाते हैं

meaning.en: just as in a pool of liquid
meaning.hi: जैसे किसी द्रव के कुण्ड में

meaning.en: foam rises only from churning
meaning.hi: झाग मथने से ही उठता है

meaning.en: only from the churning of the mind
meaning.hi: मन के मथे जाने से ही

meaning.en: many imaginings
so too
the doer is kept going by action
meaning.hi: कर्म से कर्ता चलता रहता है

meaning.en: by letting go of it he reaches peace
meaning.hi: उसे छोड़ने से शान्ति पाता है

meaning.en: having entered the southern path
he turns to face the manifold world
meaning.hi: अनेकता के संसार की ओर मुड़ जाता है

meaning.en: through the proud claim of 'I'
the ever-blessed Shiva becomes the living soul
meaning.hi: सदाशिव ही जीव बन जाता है

meaning.en: and he
through contact with nature without discernment
is confused there
having passed through hundreds of wombs
he lies down to rest
driven by the impressions carried
until release he keeps moving
meaning.hi: मुक्ति तक वह चलता ही रहता है

meaning.en: like a fish between the two banks
meaning.hi: जैसे मछली दो किनारों के बीच

meaning.en: then, by the force of time itself
meaning.hi: फिर, समय के ही वश से

meaning.en: through discernment born of self-knowledge
turning to face north
from one station to the next, step by step
meaning.hi: एक स्थान से दूसरे स्थान तक क्रम से

meaning.en: settling his own breaths in the crown of the head
meaning.hi: अपने प्राणों को सिर के शिखर में रखकर

meaning.en: living on, steady in yoga practice
meaning.hi: योगाभ्यास में स्थिर होकर जीता हुआ

meaning.en: from yoga knowledge is born
meaning.hi: योग से ज्ञान उत्पन्न होता है

meaning.en: from knowledge yoga proceeds
meaning.hi: ज्ञान से योग आगे बढ़ता है

meaning.en: always devoted to yoga and knowledge
meaning.hi: सदा योग और ज्ञान में लगा

meaning.en: that yogi never comes to ruin
he should see Shiva within what changes
meaning.hi: विकार में स्थित शिव को देखे

meaning.en: and what changes as filled with Shiva
meaning.hi: और विकार को शिव से व्याप्त

meaning.en: the one who lights up yoga
one should meditate through the yogas
with an undivided heart
in whom neither yoga nor knowledge exists
meaning.hi: जिसमें योग और ज्ञान नहीं हैं

meaning.en: his heartfelt state does not come to fruition
therefore
through the yoga of steady practice
one should restrain mind and breaths
the yogi
as if with a razor honed to a fine edge
meaning.hi: तेज़ धार वाले उस्तरे से ही

meaning.en: should cut off
the tuft of hair at the crown
meaning.hi: शिखा, सिर के शीर्ष की चोटी

meaning.en: the mind's activity made of knowledge
through the eight limbs of practice beginning with restraint
meaning.hi: यम आदि आठ अंगों के साधनों से

meaning.en: the yoga of knowledge and the yoga of action
yoga is held to be twofold
meaning.hi: योग दो प्रकार का माना गया है

meaning.en: now listen to the yoga of action
meaning.hi: अब कर्म के योग को सुनो

meaning.en: best of brahmins
of a mind that is not agitated
binding to some object, wherever it may be
meaning.hi: किसी विषय से कहीं भी बाँधना

meaning.en: that joining
best of the twice-born
and it takes two forms
meaning.hi: और वह दो रूप लेता है

meaning.en: 'this action must be done'
within the actions laid down by scripture
the constant tying of the mind
that is called the yoga of action
but when the mind, without pause
is tied to the highest good as its aim
meaning.hi: परम कल्याण को लक्ष्य बनाकर बँधता है

meaning.en: that is to be understood as the yoga of knowledge
auspicious, bringer of every attainment
whose, in the yoga as described
meaning.hi: जिसका, बताए गए लक्षण वाले योग में

meaning.en: in both kinds, an unwavering mind
he goes to the supreme good
meaning.hi: वह परम कल्याण तक जाता है

meaning.en: marked by liberation, straightaway
no craving for body and senses
meaning.hi: शरीर और इन्द्रियों के प्रति वैराग्य

meaning.en: is called self-restraint by the wise
meaning.hi: बुद्धिमानों द्वारा यम कहा जाता है

meaning.en: love for the supreme reality
unbroken, is remembered as observance
even-mindedness toward every object
meaning.hi: हर वस्तु के प्रति उदासीन भाव

meaning.en: the finest posture
this whole world
seeing it as an appearance without lasting substance
control of breath
the mind turning to face inward
is withdrawal of the senses, best of seekers
the mind becoming perfectly still
that they know as concentration
'I am that, nothing but pure awareness'
that thinking is called meditation
a complete, right forgetting of meditation
meaning.hi: ध्यान का पूरी तरह भूल जाना

meaning.en: is called absorption
non-harming, truth, not stealing
chastity, kindness and straightness
forbearance, steadiness, measured eating
and cleanliness: these are the ten restraints
meaning.hi: और शौच: ये दस यम हैं

meaning.en: austerity, contentment, faith
giving, and the worship of Hari
listening to the teaching of Vedanta
modesty and sound judgement
mantra repetition and vows
the postures, which are its limbs
svastika and the rest, O twice-born
are described
svastika: the soles of both feet
the two knees, one ahead of the other
meaning.hi: दोनों घुटने, एक आगे एक पीछे

meaning.en: so placed, this is declared the seat
meaning.hi: ऐसा करके बैठना आसन कहा गया है

meaning.en: the right ankle on the left
should be set at the side of the back
and the left likewise on the right
meaning.hi: और बायाँ उसी तरह दाईं ओर

meaning.en: gomukha, like the face of a cow
raising one foot onto the other thigh
meaning.hi: एक पैर को दूसरी जाँघ पर चढ़ाकर

meaning.en: sits without moving
this, which destroys wrongdoing
meaning.hi: यह, जो पाप को नष्ट करता है

meaning.en: is called the hero's seat
closing the anus with the two ankles
meaning.hi: दोनों टखनों से गुदा को बन्द करके

meaning.en: crossed in reverse, with mind collected
this becomes the seat of yoga
so the knowers of yoga know
meaning.hi: ऐसा योग के जानकार जानते हैं

meaning.en: places upon the thighs
when both soles of the feet
this is the lotus seat
removing all illness and poison
meaning.hi: सब रोगों और विषों को हरने वाला

meaning.en: having set the lotus seat firmly
then the two big toes
with the hands crossed behind
it becomes the bound lotus
inserting the hands between knees and thighs
meaning.hi: हाथों को घुटनों और जाँघों के बीच डालकर

meaning.en: one should rest them on the ground
poised in the air
the rooster posture
staying in the rooster's lock
binding the neck with the arms
lies face upward like a tortoise
meaning.hi: कछुए की तरह पीठ के बल लेटता है

meaning.en: this is the upturned tortoise
taking the big toes with the hands
meaning.hi: हाथों से पैरों के अँगूठे पकड़कर

meaning.en: as far as the ears
drawn like a bow pulled back by an archer
meaning.hi: धनुर्धर द्वारा खींचे धनुष की तरह

meaning.en: is called the bow posture
pressing the perineum with the ankles
crossed the other way
spreading the hands over the knees
the seat in the form of a lion
the ankles beneath the scrotum
setting them on both sides of the perineum
binding the feet with the hands
it becomes the auspicious seat
both sides of the perineum
with the ankles, crossed the other way
pressing them, this seat
is called the free seat
pressing the earth down firmly
with the palms of both hands
setting the elbows at the sides of the navel
meaning.hi: कोहनियों को नाभि के बगल में रखकर

meaning.en: like a peacock
with head and feet raised high
meaning.hi: सिर और पैर ऊँचे उठाए हुए

meaning.en: is accepted as the peacock posture
the right foot at the root of the left thigh
meaning.hi: दायाँ पैर बाईं जाँघ की जड़ पर

meaning.en: with the hand wound round the knee
meaning.hi: घुटने के चारों ओर लिपटे हाथ से

meaning.en: the left big toe held with the left hand
meaning.hi: बाएँ हाथ से पकड़ा बायाँ अँगूठा

meaning.en: the fish seat
pressing the perineum with the left heel
the right heel above the genitals
seated evenly with the body straight
is called the seat of the accomplished
stretching both legs out on the ground
meaning.hi: दोनों पैरों को ज़मीन पर फैलाकर

meaning.en: holding the big toes with the arms, carefully
meaning.hi: बाँहों से अँगूठों को सावधानी से

meaning.en: the forehead upon the knees
is called the stretch of the back
by whatever means
it becomes comfortable to hold
that is called the easy seat
the one who is unable should practise it
meaning.hi: असमर्थ व्यक्ति उसी का अभ्यास करे

meaning.en: by whom posture is mastered
by him the three worlds are won
by the restraints and the observances
and well disciplined by the postures
having first purified the channels
one should practise breath control
the body's measure, by one's own fingers
meaning.hi: अपनी उँगलियों से शरीर का माप

meaning.en: is ninety-six finger-widths long
the breath exceeds the body
by a measure of twelve finger-widths
the air residing in the body
by the fire arising in the body
making it less or equal through yoga
meaning.hi: योग से उसे कम या बराबर करता हुआ

meaning.en: is held to be a knower of Brahman
in the middle of the body, the seat of fire
meaning.hi: शरीर के मध्य में अग्नि का स्थान

meaning.en: glowing like heated gold
triangular in two-footed beings
square in four-footed beings
circular for birds
six-sided for snakes
eight-sided for the moisture-born
in it, bright like a lamp
the seat of the bulb in humans
egg-shaped
in animals, birds and quadrupeds
it is taken to be the middle of the belly
meaning.hi: वह पेट का मध्य माना गया है

meaning.en: its centre is known as the navel
there is a wheel of twelve spokes
meaning.hi: वहाँ बारह अरों वाला चक्र है

meaning.en: on them, Vishnu and other forms
I, stationed there
turn the wheel by my own maya
meaning.hi: अपनी माया से चक्र घुमाता हूँ

meaning.en: the soul wanders on the spokes
in turn, O best of the twice-born
staying in the middle of a cage of threads
meaning.hi: धागों के पिंजरे के बीच स्थित

meaning.en: just as a spider moves about
the soul moves mounted on the breath
meaning.hi: जीव प्राण पर सवार होकर विचरता है

meaning.en: not without it
above it is the seat of kundali
crosswise and upward from the navel
she has the form of the eightfold nature
and is coiled in eight turns
meaning.hi: और आठ फेरों में कुण्डलित है

meaning.en: the flow of the airs, as it should be
and the fire and the rest, always
all around the sides of the bulb
meaning.hi: कन्द के पार्श्वों के चारों ओर

meaning.en: remaining always as if blocking it
enclosing with her own mouth
the mouth of the aperture of Brahman
at the time of yoga, by the breath with fire
meaning.hi: योग के समय, अग्नि सहित वायु से

meaning.en: being awakened
flashes forth in the space of the heart
meaning.hi: हृदय के आकाश में चमकती है

meaning.en: in serpent form, blazing bright
two finger-widths above the anus
and as far below the genitals
the middle of the body in humans
for quadrupeds, the middle of the chest
for the others, in the middle of the belly
meaning.hi: दूसरों में, पेट के मध्य में

meaning.en: joined with the in-breath and out-breath
where the four kinds and the two are joined
meaning.hi: जहाँ चार प्रकार और दो जुड़ते हैं

meaning.en: in the body's centre, with the sushumna
meaning.hi: शरीर के मध्य में, सुषुम्ना के साथ

meaning.en: the channel standing in the middle of the bulb
meaning.hi: कन्द के मध्य में स्थित नाड़ी

meaning.en: sushumna, firmly established
resembling a lotus fibre
straight, running upward
meaning.hi: सीधी, ऊपर की ओर चलने वाली

meaning.en: as far as the opening of Brahman
with a tube shining like lightning
Vishnu's own, the channel of Brahman
the path to reaching final release
ida and pingala
stand on its left and right
meaning.hi: उसके बाएँ और दाएँ स्थित हैं

meaning.en: ida rises from the bulb
up to the left nostril
and pingala, rising from it
up to the right nostril
gandhari and hastijihva
two other channels are placed
in front of it and behind it
toward the left and right eyes
meaning.hi: बाईं और दाईं आँख की ओर

meaning.en: the channels pusha and yashasvini
rise from that same place
as far as the left and right ears
alambusa, from the root of the anus
the fair channel going downward
stretching to the end of the genitals
as far as the big toes
and kaushiki going down from the bulb
meaning.hi: और कन्द से नीचे जाती कौशिकी

meaning.en: these, being of ten kinds
are said to arise from the bulb
meaning.hi: कन्द से उत्पन्न कही गई हैं

meaning.en: many channels rooted in these
meaning.hi: इन्हीं में जड़ वाली बहुत-सी नाड़ियाँ

meaning.en: both gross and subtle channels
seventy-two thousand
channels, large and fine
they cannot be counted
rooted in the large ones, of varied kinds
meaning.hi: मोटी जड़ों वाली, अनेक प्रकार की

meaning.en: as in a leaf of the sacred fig
so the fine and thick are spread
meaning.hi: वैसे ही महीन और मोटी फैली हैं

meaning.en: prana, apana and samana
udana and vyana
naga, kurma and krikara
devadatta and dhananjaya
they move in the ten channels
the ten airs, prana and the rest
among them the five from prana are chief
meaning.hi: उनमें प्राण आदि पाँच प्रधान हैं

meaning.en: and among those, two
or rather, prana alone is the eldest
meaning.hi: या प्राण ही सबसे बड़ा है

meaning.en: which bears the individual self
meaning.hi: जो जीवात्मा को धारण करता है

meaning.en: the space between mouth and nose
the heart, the region of the navel
apana moves
O brahmin
in the anus and genitals
in the thighs and knees
samana, in all the limbs
established, pervading everything
udana, dwelling in all the joints
in the feet and the hands too
vyana, in the ears, thighs and hips
meaning.hi: व्यान, कानों, जाँघों और कमर में

meaning.en: and in the ankles, shoulders and throat
meaning.hi: और टखनों, कन्धों और गले में

meaning.en: the five airs beginning with naga
are settled in skin, bone and the rest
meaning.hi: त्वचा, हड्डी आदि में स्थित हैं

meaning.en: the water and food in the belly
meaning.hi: पेट में स्थित जल और अन्न

meaning.en: the juices and the rest, blended even
prana, placed in the middle of the belly
meaning.hi: पेट के मध्य में स्थित प्राण

meaning.en: makes them each separate
such activity, prana
performs from its own separate place
meaning.hi: अपने अलग स्थान से करता है

meaning.en: the apana air, of urine and the rest
carries out the release
the movements of prana, apana and the rest
are done by the vyana air
meaning.hi: व्यान वायु द्वारा की जाती हैं

meaning.en: what is in the body is raised up
meaning.hi: शरीर में स्थित ऊपर उठाया जाता है

meaning.en: by udana, the wind
the nourishing and so on of the body
samana always performs
naga, whose work is belching and the like
meaning.hi: नाग, जिसका काम डकार आदि है

meaning.en: kurma, the closer of the eyes and so on
meaning.hi: कूर्म, आँखें आदि बन्द करने वाला

meaning.en: krikara, the maker of sneezes
devadatta, doer of sleep and the like
of the swelling and such of a dead body
meaning.hi: मृत शरीर के फूलने आदि का

meaning.en: dhananjaya is declared
the distinctions of channels and of airs
and the places of the airs
and their various activities
having known these, O best of your own
meaning.hi: हे अपनों में श्रेष्ठ, यह जानकर ही

meaning.en: one should strive to purify the channels
meaning.hi: नाड़ियों की शुद्धि के लिए यत्न करे

meaning.en: equipped with the knowledge stated before
reaching a secluded place
free of all ties
complete with the aids of yoga
there, on a clean wooden seat
meaning.hi: वहाँ, शुभ लकड़ी के आसन पर

meaning.en: on a seat made ready
with darbha, kusha grass, black antelope skin and so on
meaning.hi: दर्भ, कुश, कृष्ण मृगचर्म आदि से

meaning.en: the seat, of such a height
and twice that in length
sitting properly on the seat
in svastika or another, as one likes
the brahmin, having first fixed his seat
straight in body, collected in mind
with eyes set on the tip of the nose
meaning.hi: नाक के सिरे पर टिकी आँखों वाला

meaning.en: not letting teeth touch teeth
meaning.hi: दाँतों से दाँतों को न छूता हुआ

meaning.en: placing the tongue on the palate
at ease in mind, free of illness
with the head bowed slightly
binding with the seal of yoga
the hands, in the prescribed manner
one should practise breath control
expelling, and filling with air
cleansing, and expelling again
the exercising of the air through four
is called breath control
with the right hand alone
one should press the nostril
then slowly, slowly, outward
one should send the air of pingala
filling with air through ida
O brahmin, for sixteen measures
then one should hold what was filled
for sixty-four measures
properly, over thirty-two measures
should release the air through pingala
thus it should be done again and again
in reverse order and in order
the body, like a brimming pot
meaning.hi: शरीर को भरे घड़े की तरह

meaning.en: one should hold it filled with the wind
by the filling, all the channels
are filled with the wind
when this is done, O brahmin
the ten airs move freely
and the lotus of the heart too
opens, clearly blossoming
there one should see the supreme self
Vasudeva, free of stain
at dawn, at midday, at dusk
and at midnight, the retentions
gradually, up to eighty
should be practised four times
doing it for a single day only
is freed from all sins
meaning.hi: सब पापों से मुक्त होता है

meaning.en: beyond three years
a person devoted to breath control
the yogi becomes accomplished in yoga
meaning.hi: योगी योग में सिद्ध हो जाता है

meaning.en: master of the breath, master of the senses
eating little and sleeping little
meaning.hi: थोड़ा खाने और थोड़ा सोने वाला

meaning.en: becomes radiant and strong
overcoming untimely death
he would gain a long life
that which produces sweat
that breath control is the lowest
that in which the body trembles
is middling among breath controls
that in which the body rises
that is declared the highest
in the lowest, of illnesses and sins
meaning.hi: निचले में, रोगों और पापों का

meaning.en: there is destruction; in the middle, again
meaning.hi: नाश होता है; मध्यम में फिर

meaning.en: the destruction of sin, disease and great illness
meaning.hi: पाप, रोग और महाव्याधि का नाश

meaning.en: comes about in the highest, again
with little urine and little stool
meaning.hi: थोड़े मूत्र और थोड़े मल वाला

meaning.en: light in body, measured in eating
meaning.hi: हल्के शरीर वाला, नपा-तुला खाने वाला

meaning.en: keen in senses, sharp in mind
meaning.hi: तेज़ इन्द्रियों और पैनी बुद्धि वाला

meaning.en: knower of the three times, self-possessed
setting aside out-breath and in-breath
the one who does retention alone
does it at the three times
for him nothing is hard to attain
at the navel-bulb and the tip of the nose
meaning.hi: नाभि-कन्द में और नाक के सिरे पर

meaning.en: and at the big toe, with effort
meaning.hi: और पैर के अँगूठे पर, यत्नपूर्वक

meaning.en: one should hold the breaths with the mind
meaning.hi: मन से प्राणों को धारण करे

meaning.en: at the junction times, or always
wholly freed from all diseases
meaning.hi: सब रोगों से पूरी तरह मुक्त

meaning.en: the yogi lives, his weariness gone
the ailments of the belly are destroyed
meaning.hi: पेट के रोगों का नाश होता है

meaning.en: by holding at the navel-bulb
from holding at the nose-tip, long
meaning.hi: नाक के सिरे पर धारणा से, लम्बी

meaning.en: life comes, and lightness of body
meaning.hi: आयु और शरीर का हल्कापन होता है

meaning.en: when the hour before dawn arrives
drawing in the air with the tongue
for one who drinks it for three months
meaning.hi: तीन महीने पीने वाले के लिए

meaning.en: great mastery of speech arises
meaning.hi: वाणी की महान सिद्धि होती है

meaning.en: and by practice for six months
meaning.hi: और छह महीने के अभ्यास से

meaning.en: the destruction of major diseases
wherever the air is held
meaning.hi: जहाँ-जहाँ वायु धारण की जाती है

meaning.en: in a limb spoiled by disease and the like
meaning.hi: रोग आदि से दूषित अंग में

meaning.en: by the mere holding of the air
meaning.hi: वायु को धारण करने से ही

meaning.en: one gains health of that very part
just by holding the mind
meaning.hi: मन को धारण करने से ही

meaning.en: the breath becomes held
the means of fixing the mind
meaning.hi: मन को स्थापित करने का साधन

meaning.en: is told, O foremost of the twice-born
gathering in the senses
from their objects, collected
drawing apana upward
one should hold it above the belly
binding with the two hands
the ears and other senses, as is proper
for one practising by the path described
meaning.hi: बताए मार्ग से अभ्यास करने वाले का

meaning.en: the mind comes under one's own control
meaning.hi: मन अपने वश में होता है

meaning.en: through control of the mind, the vital air
is always kept under one's control
meaning.hi: सदा अपने वश में रखी जाती है

meaning.en: the breath in the two nostrils
flows by turns
and among those three channels
for however long this one moves
in the right-hand opening of shankhini
the breath of living beings
and for that same time again
moves without break on the lunar side
meaning.hi: चान्द्र पक्ष में लगातार चलता है

meaning.en: with the air moving in this order
meaning.hi: इस क्रम से चलती वायु से

meaning.en: the one who has mastered the breath
day and night and the fortnight
the month, the season, the half-year and so on
turned inward, one would know
the divisions of time, being composed
one's own limbs, beginning with the big toe
from the throbbing
and by ill omens, of life too
meaning.hi: और अरिष्टों से, जीवन का भी

meaning.en: one would know one's own decline
knowing this, one should strive to reach final freedom
meaning.hi: यह जानकर कैवल्य-प्राप्ति के लिए यत्न करे

meaning.en: the best knower of yoga
in the big toe and the thumb
meaning.hi: पैर और हाथ के अँगूठे में

meaning.en: for whom the throbbing is not felt
for him, after a year
meaning.hi: उसके लिए एक वर्ष के बाद

meaning.en: life comes to its end
at the wrist and likewise the ankle
meaning.hi: कलाई में और उसी तरह टखने में

meaning.en: for whom the throbbing vanishes
for him, a limit of six months
meaning.hi: उसके लिए छह महीने की सीमा

meaning.en: would be the span of life
one whose throbbing at the elbow is gone
his span is three months
at the side of the belly and the genitals
meaning.hi: पेट और जननेन्द्रिय के बगल में

meaning.en: when the throbbing is not perceived
life's limit is a month
and on seeing the next, half of that
meaning.hi: और अगले के दिखने पर उसका आधा

meaning.en: when it has retreated to the stomach's gate
meaning.hi: आमाशय के द्वार पर आश्रित होने पर

meaning.en: life is ten days
one who sees a light like a firefly
his life is half of that
on not seeing the tongue's tip, three
meaning.hi: जीभ की नोक न दिखने पर तीन

meaning.en: days is the self's stay
on seeing a flame, death
comes surely in two days
meaning.hi: दो दिन में निश्चित होती है

meaning.en: these and similar omens
meaning.hi: ऐसे और इसी तरह के अरिष्ट

meaning.en: seeing what marks life's decline
one should apply oneself to the highest good
devoted wholly to japa and meditation
meditating on the supreme self with the mind
meaning.hi: मन से परमात्मा का ध्यान करके

meaning.en: one would attain its very form
if at the eighteen kinds of
vital points there is holding
drawing it from place to place
that is called withdrawal
the big toe and the ankle
and likewise the middle of the shin
meaning.hi: और उसी तरह पिंडली का मध्य

meaning.en: the middle of the thighs and their root
the anus and the heart
the genitals and the centre of the body
the navel, the throat and the elbow
the root of the palate and the root of the nose
meaning.hi: तालु की जड़ और नाक की जड़

meaning.en: and the ring of the eyes
between the brows, the forehead
the upper root, and the knees
and the root of the hands
these are the great ones, O twice-born
in the body made of five elements
meaning.hi: पाँच तत्त्वों से बने शरीर में

meaning.en: in these five elements
the holding of the mind, which
of one disciplined by the restraints and the rest
meaning.hi: यम आदि से युक्त व्यक्ति का

meaning.en: that is concentration
the means of crossing the ocean of worldly life
from the knees down to the feet
is held to be the region of earth
meaning.hi: पृथ्वी का स्थान माना जाता है

meaning.en: yellow and square
the earth, marked with the thunderbolt
to be contemplated for five ghatikas
raising the wind into it there
from the knees to the hips
is declared the region of water
meaning.hi: जल का स्थान कहा गया है

meaning.en: shaped like a half-moon
white, bearing a silver mark
to be contemplated, raising the breath into water
meaning.hi: जल में साँस चढ़ाकर ध्यान करना चाहिए

meaning.en: for ten ghatikas
from the hips to the middle of the body
meaning.hi: कमर से शरीर के मध्य तक

meaning.en: is declared the region of fire
meaning.hi: अग्नि का स्थान कहा गया है

meaning.en: there the fire, the colour of vermilion
blazing, and for fifteen
to be contemplated for those ghatikas
holding the breath in retention as stated
meaning.hi: बताए अनुसार प्राण को कुम्भक में रखकर

meaning.en: above the navel up to the nose
meaning.hi: नाभि के ऊपर से नाक तक

meaning.en: there indeed is the region of air
altar-shaped and smoke-coloured
meaning.hi: वेदी के आकार का और धूम्र वर्ण

meaning.en: the mighty element, wind
to be contemplated by retention alone
meaning.hi: केवल कुम्भक से ध्यान करना चाहिए

meaning.en: placing the breath, the wind, there
twenty ghatikas; then, from there
meaning.hi: बीस घड़ी; उसके बाद वहाँ से

meaning.en: from the nose up to the cave of Brahman
the region of space; the sky there
meaning.hi: आकाश का स्थान; वहाँ का आकाश

meaning.en: with the lustre of crushed collyrium
placing the wind in space
with effort, through retention alone
in the earth-portion of the body
the four-armed, crowned one
the yogi, on Hari as Aniruddha
should strive for release from rebirth
in the water-portion the yogi should fill
Narayana, with his mind raised high
Pradyumna in the fire
in the air-portion, Sankarshana next
in the space-portion, the supreme self
Vasudeva, one should always remember
the reaching of that comes very soon
for the one who practises, without doubt
first settling into the yoga posture
with palms joined at the heart
with eyes set on the tip of the nose
meaning.hi: नाक के सिरे पर टिकी आँखों वाला

meaning.en: and the tongue placed on the palate
not letting teeth touch teeth
meaning.hi: दाँतों से दाँत न छुआते हुए

meaning.en: upright in body, collected in mind
one should restrain the troop of senses
meaning.hi: इन्द्रियों के समूह का संयम करे

meaning.en: with a pure understanding turned to the self
meaning.hi: आत्मा की ओर शुद्ध बुद्धि से

meaning.en: contemplation of Vasudeva
the highest, the supreme self
whose very being pervades all
meditation that grants final freedom
for one watch, on Vasudeva
whoever contemplates with breath held
the wrongdoing gathered over seven births
of that yogi is destroyed
meaning.hi: उस योगी का नष्ट होता है

meaning.en: beginning from the navel-bulb
up to the region of the heart
one should know it as the waking state
the dream state dwells in the throat
deep sleep is in the middle of the palate
the fourth is set between the brows
the supreme Brahman beyond the fourth
one should discern at the aperture of Brahman
beginning from the waking state
up to the inside of the cave of Brahman
there is this self of the fourth state
at the end of the fourth it is called Vishnu
meaning.hi: तुरीय के अन्त में विष्णु कहलाता है

meaning.en: wholly joined with meditation
in the utterly pure sky
bright as ten million suns, ever risen
meaning.hi: करोड़ सूर्यों-सी दीप्ति वाला, नित्य उदित

meaning.en: Adhokshaja, beyond the senses
seated on the lotus of the heart
or one may meditate on him as the universe
studded with many forms
possessing many faces
endowed with many arms
adorned with many weapons
the god bearing many colours
meaning.hi: अनेक वर्ण धारण करने वाले देव

meaning.en: peaceful and fierce, weapons raised
crowded with many eyes
shining like ten million suns
meaning.hi: करोड़ सूर्यों के समान प्रभा वाले

meaning.en: for the yogi who meditates
every movement of the mind perishes
meaning.hi: मन की सब वृत्तियाँ नष्ट होती हैं

meaning.en: set in the middle of the heart-lotus
the imperishable light of consciousness
round like a kadamba blossom
meaning.hi: कदम्ब के गोले के आकार का

meaning.en: beyond the fourth, higher than the highest
endless, made of bliss
made of awareness, shining, all-pervading
like a lamp in a windless place
with the lustre of an uncut gem
for the yogi who meditates on this
meaning.hi: इसका ध्यान करते उस योगी की

meaning.en: liberation rests in the palm of his hand
of the god whose form is the universe
whatever form it may be
grosser, subtle, or something else
seeing it in the lotus of the heart
to the yogi who meditates, he
meaning.hi: ध्यान करते योगी के लिए जो

meaning.en: shines forth directly
and fruits such as minuteness
arise with ease
of the individual self and of the supreme
if thus for both
I alone am the supreme Brahman
the settled state, 'Brahman am I'
that is to be known as samadhi
free of every movement of mind
the yogi becomes Brahman
he does not go back into worldly life
having thus purified the elements
meaning.hi: इस प्रकार तत्त्वों को शुद्ध करके

meaning.en: the yogi, with a mind free of craving
as a fire with no fuel
dies down of itself
meaning.hi: अपने आप शान्त हो जाती है

meaning.en: with nothing to grasp, mind and breath
meaning.hi: ग्राह्य के अभाव में मन और प्राण

meaning.en: joined with certain knowledge
the soul merged in the pure, supreme being
meaning.hi: शुद्ध परम सत्ता में लीन जीव

meaning.en: like a lump of rock salt
meaning.hi: सेंधा नमक की डली की तरह

meaning.en: the whole tangle of delusion's net
he sees the universe as a dream
he who moves as in deep sleep
meaning.hi: जो सुषुप्ति की तरह विचरता है

meaning.en: wholly unmoving in his own nature
